contents.text: How many employees did Nasdaq have at the end of 2025?

The global female employee base in 2025 was approximately 36%, and the minority representation in the U.S. was approximately 33% (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART I > Item 1. Business). However, the total number of employees is not stated in the provided excerpts.
